title: POD-Attention: Unlocking Full Prefill-Decode Overlap for Faster LLM Inference
technique: fused SM-aware attention kernel that runs prefill and decode attention concurrently within hybrid batches

optimized_metrics.evidence: POD-Attention aims to maximize the utilization of both compute and memory bandwidth
While prior work has focused on optimizing the linear operations [23, 33, 62], they do not optimize the attention computation of a hybrid batch.

headline_claim.text: POD-Attention speeds up attention computation by up to 59% (mean 28%), enabling higher throughput and lower latency LLM inference compared to the use of independently optimized prefill and decode attention kernels.

reported_metrics.where: Tables 5-6: % requests with stalls at 200 ms / 500 ms

metric_definitions.definition_quote: produces the first output token, whose latency is called time-to-first-token (TTFT)
metric_definitions.notes: Prefill phase latency; queueing not stated explicitly but online TTFT reaches 10+ s at load, so it evidently includes queueing.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: The latency taken to generate each output token is called time-between-tokens (TBT).
metric_definitions.notes: Per-token decode latency; stalls = TBT above a threshold.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: For offline inference, we report the number of requests processed per minute.
Request latency can be used to approximate system throughput in online inference.

slo_spec: TBT stall thresholds 200 ms and 500 ms ('TBT SLO'); fraction of requests with at least one stall reported; no attainment target
load_regime: offline fixed batch of long requests (throughput); online QPS sweep on 2K-request workloads
tradeoff_acknowledged: Explicit TTFT-vs-TBT trade-off between vLLM (prefill-prioritizing: low TTFT, high TBT) and Sarathi (low TBT, higher TTFT); POD narrows it. Sarathi has some throughput reduction vs vLLM.
workloads: internal enterprise trace (mean ctx 10.5K), arXiv-Summarization (mean 9.5K); 16K-token offline requests
extractor_notes: Optimizes a kernel; end-to-end evidence is via Sarathi-Serve. Tail (P99) TBT and stall fraction are used as evidence of benefit, but the method itself only targets kernel runtime/utilization. | TAIL AUDIT 2026-10-06: TBT tail stat -> n/a (metric targeted, percentile only reported)

tail_audit.metrics: TBT P99, TTFT P99 (reported vs vLLM/Sarathi)
tail_audit.correction: Demote TBT P99 'objective' to reported. Kernel paper; objective is attention runtime/utilization/throughput.
